note: Small Rio Grande NF campground in a grassy meadow on the banks of the Rio Grande, 8.5 miles west of Creede off CO 149, then ~0.5 mile on FSR 529 (signed Rio Grande Fisherman's Area). The sites sit below the highway on the river bottom, so there is little road noise. The FS does not recommend it for large RVs or long or wide trailers because the access road down to the site is narrow and steep. No trash service: pack out all garbage. Fishing access (Colorado license required) and a summer raft put-in/take-out; the river is close enough to be a hazard to unsupervised children. --Claude

flags: CRITERIA (rig length, for a human): the FS says 'It is not recommended for large RVs or long/wide trailers because the access road going down into the site is narrow and steep' and, under Parking, 'Maximum spur length is 25 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' Under the curation rule a stated length of 23 ft or more outranks 'large RVs not recommended' (Spring Creek 6259), so this reads as a keep, but the warning is about the access road and only some spurs reach 25 ft. The inclusion_evidence's 2020 Campendium 33-ft Class A report is more than 3 years old and was dropped from the note.
